description: This file defines the FormatterInterface interface for Drupal field formatter plugins, specifying methods for configuration, rendering, and applicability checks.

classes.name: FormatterInterface
classes.description: Interface for field formatter plugins in Drupal, extending PluginSettingsInterface, with methods for configuration, rendering, and applicability.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Returns a form to configure settings for the formatter.

methods.name: settingsSummary
methods.description: Returns a short summary of the formatter settings.

methods.name: prepareView
methods.description: Loads additional information for field values being displayed.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Builds a renderable array for a fully themed field.

methods.name: viewElements
methods.description: Builds a renderable array for individual field values.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Checks if the formatter can be used for a specific field.
